sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.rarity = 'rare'
  AND c.types = 'Enchantment'
  AND c.name = 'Abundance'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM legalities AS l
      WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
        AND l.status = 'Legal'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM legalities AS l
      WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
        AND l.status <> 'Legal'
  );
